new_overlap_decisions.reason: arXiv:2606.15378 restricts receptive fields and probes layers, finding long-range information carried mainly by full attention
layer-wise NIAH probe gains concentrate in middle full-attention layers across six from-scratch hybrid families
scaling and retrieval-head traces already model efficient mixers as changing emergence speed of full-attention retrieval
entropy, Q/K distance, gradient norms, and distance-gradient influence are already used to explain hybrid learning
Large-Window Laziness and SWA-128/512/2048 comparisons directly occupy this mechanism
SWA-128-NoPE already applies NoPE only to full layers and validates scale/long-context gains
the 72-model study crosses six mixers and five ratios, shows language/recall separation, and recommends gated 3:1 to 6:1 hybrids
DtR repeatedly evaluates and commits the best layer replacement, outperforming uniform, random, and local-sensitivity layouts
DtR's probe impact score correlates with order but loses 2.6 to 3.8 task points to greedy feedback at the same replacement count

surviving_hypotheses.statement: A predictor frozen on discovery layouts forecasts the rank and absolute failure margins of unseen non-uniform full/recurrent placements trained from scratch across tasks, scales, and a different mixer without evaluating those held-out layouts, beyond count/ratio, middle-full roles, scaling, probes, sensitivity, greedy conversion, and joint-gate baselines.
concessions: middle full attention as the main retrieval carrier is prior art
efficient mixers as optimization priors and retrieval-head emergence dynamics are prior art
small-window pressure and full-layer NoPE are prior art
mixer-by-ratio language/recall tradeoffs are prior art
greedy non-uniform replacement and static probe substitutability are prior art
required_baselines: uniform count and ratio using mixer-specific controls
Rethinking Hybrid LongPPL scaling and middle-layer/retrieval-head diagnostics
systematic HGRN-2 and GatedDeltaNet 3:1 to 6:1 recipes
independent sensitivity and static hidden-state probe impact
DtR greedy validation-feedback replacement where conversion is applicable
random placements matched on count, state, parameters, FLOPs, and training compute
held_out: one different recurrent mixer or cache representation
surviving_hypotheses.success: the frozen predictor beats every baseline on held-out rank, margin, and calibration with paired uncertainty, and fixed-budget role interventions move diagnostics and end quality as predicted
falsifiers: middle-full presence, count, ratio, or LongPPL scaling explains equal variance
greedy conversion or joint gates match held-out choice without explanatory loss
coefficients or rankings fail across scales/mixers
fixed-budget interventions do not move quality
predictor requires seeing held-out layout outcomes

rejected_hypotheses.reason: the main integration, long-range carrier, optimization-prior, and training-diagnostic roles are directly occupied by arXiv:2606.15378v1
v3/v4 complete-source and missing-source overlap remains unchanged
